<div class="doxyMemberDoc">




<p>Folder for <span class="doxyComputerOutput">qar_streaming.log</span>, or NULL for no log file. The file starts empty on each init and rolls over once it is a day old or 256 MiB, to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">qar_streaming.&lt;UTC time&gt;.log</span>; the oldest of those are deleted so the log takes at most 3 GiB. UTF-8, like every path in this API (see Text encoding).</p>
